However, very little cell biological work has been done on the sister linages to animals.
We detected 6,466 proteins, corresponding to 68.4% of the predicted Capsaspora proteome, and assigned high-confidence localizations to 3,106 of them across 13 subcellular compartments.

Double-blind period has two parts, 50% (adult only) until the interim analysis (a proof-concept part analogous to a phase 2b study), and 50% (adult and children) after the interim analysis.

3885164ec3d4d55a.title: What is pathogenicity? Structural vulnerabilities lead to distinct phenotypes in a membrane protein, ATP1A3
digest: Distinct protein features of pathogenic variants are illustrated here for a gene with an extraordinarily wide range of neurological syndromes: ATP1A3, the neuronal Na,K-ATPase.
Vulnerable structure features produce mechanistically different consequences, from loss or gain of function to maladaptive cell biological responses.
Variants in specific structural elements (glycines, prolines, and {beta}-sheets) link severe phenotype to impaired folding during biosynthesis.

d81b3b309fd5e6c0.title: Compass Pathways CEO: Psychedelics company will ‘go slow before we go fast’
digest: The CEO of Compass Pathways said Wednesday that the company, which is preparing to complete the submission of its psychedelic therapy for regulatory review this quarter, will “go slow before we go fast,” warning that negative patient or provider experiences early in the launch could damage the broader sector.
As the psychedelics field races toward its first potential approval by the Food and Drug Administration, the executive, Kabir Nath, underscored that a cautious rollout would be essential.
But he also said the mental health field was on the brink of a major change.

d376b4008fb196d9.title: Hidden race disparities in cancer treatment toxicity
digest: Large-scale analysis of real-world data reveals racial disparities in the occurrence of immune-related adverse events during cancer immunotherapy — which were not evident in trial data, owing to the enrollment of mostly white patients.

7f0ffab46fdd7f2d.title: Heterogeneity in secondary follicle development buffers the lifespan of activated oocytes to optimize female fertility in mice
digest: Liang, Yang and colleagues map the developmental dynamics of activated oocytes and folliculogenesis across the reproductive lifespan using lineage tracing in mice.
Their work reveals marked heterogeneity in the lifespan of activated oocytes in growing follicles, which form a secondary ovarian reserve that buffers oocyte utilization and sustains fertility.

digest: BOSTON — This fall, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, where 95% of students are STEM majors, enrolled nearly 500 fewer graduate students — a 20% drop compared to 2024.
The reduction is a direct result of a $100 million cut in federal research awards to the institution in that same timespan, MIT President Sally Kornbluth said at the STAT Summit Wednesday in Boston.

digest: Menopause is an important biological transition with up to 72 symptoms that shapes aging trajectories across organs and encompasses ~40% of the female lifespan.
Although menopause awareness is increasing, research on strategies for menopause symptom management and optimizing health in the postmenopausal period is lacking.
